editorialBody.purpose: Blog prose, financial analysis, and annotations.

editorialLabel.purpose: Finance controls, dates, and data labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A signal action for the page's primary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--accent-color, #35ff6b); border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 18px; background: #010803; color: #35ff6b; font: 700 0.88rem/1.2 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .25s ease-out, box-shadow .25s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(53,255,107,.16); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9ffd7; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet action that does not compete with the live signal.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid rgba(53,255,107,.28); border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 18px; background: rgba(53,255,107,.06); color: #c9ffd7; font: 700 .88rem/1.2 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #35ff6b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #35ff6b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A layered console surface for grouped information.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid rgba(53,255,107,.32); border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; background: #010803; color: #c9ffd7; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.34); font-family: 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-panel strong { color: #68c77d; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #35ff6b; font-size: 2rem; }

components.name: Signal Chip
components.description: Compact metadata or selected metric state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgba(53,255,107,.3); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 12px; background: rgba(53,255,107,.08); color: #68c77d; font: 700 .78rem/1.2 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; }

components.name: Console Input
components.description: A recessed search or filter field.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(53,255,107,.32); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #010402; color: #c9ffd7; font: 400 1rem/1.4 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #35ff6b; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #35ff6b; }

components.name: Console Navigation
components.description: Compact dark navigation with active signal state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(53,255,107,.24); border-radius: 10px; background: #010402; } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 10px; color: #68c77d; font: 700 .82rem/1.2 'Courier New', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a.active, .ds-nav a:hover { color: #35ff6b; background: rgba(53,255,107,.08); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #35ff6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A personal analysis terminal with dark layered surfaces, precise phosphor-green signals, measured motion, and visible system state. Dense information remains legible through alignment, hierarchy, and interaction.

rules.name: The Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Brightness and glow identify activity or hierarchy.

rules.name: The Restrained Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow supports tonal or offset depth and never substitutes for structure.

dos: Align financial values with tabular numerals.
Provide static equivalents for interactive explanations.
donts: Do not cover every panel in equal glow.
Do not sacrifice body-copy measure for terminal styling.
Do not add colors without a semantic data role.
